gaps.sentence: The experiments ___ (conduct) under strict laboratory conditions last year.

gaps.sentence: Nothing ___ about the incident until the inquiry began.

gaps.sentence: The escaped prisoner ___ (believe) to be hiding in the mountains.

gaps.sentence: Your contract will ___ for a further twelve months.

gaps.sentence: Your luggage ___ (weigh) at check-in, so allow extra time.

gaps.sentence: The divers ___ (know) to have been working without insurance.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript is said ___ in a private vault for decades.
